summary: No honest log failed to verify, no log producer failed, and no proof came near a per-transaction limit, in the states exercised. Randomized differential harness (scratch RGLOG/rglog2.lua plus a random bare-metal guest RGLOG/guest/fuzz.c+entry.S): machine B executes sampled mcycles through logged uarch steps (log_step_uarch, re-verified by verify_step_uarch through the Lua/JSON path and by the regenerated Solidity step on the EVM harness), closes each mcycle with log_step_uarch at position 2^20-1 + log_reset_uarch verified as stepThenReset, and delivers inputs with log_send_cmio_response + log_step_uarch verified as sendCmioResponseThenStep; machine A runs natively and every sampled mcycle's canonical hash is compared with A (R2) and, at a rejecting mcycle, with the pre-delivery root. Runs: 9 bare-metal seeds (about 110k logged uarch steps, about 1000 sampled uarch mcycles, about 5000 EVM verifications, 30+ stopping mcycles including 10 rejections with snapshot restore and next delivery from the pre-delivery machine), one with two flash drives (rw, and read-only prefilled with PTE-like words used as page tables), one under the ASan+UBSan build, plus 3 Linux valid-template runs (echo app, deliveries incl. 30-60 KB payloads). The guest runs random instruction blocks at M/S/U with random Sv39/Sv48/Sv57-write satp, random PTE flags (A/D clear, reserved bits, W-without-R, misaligned superpages, PTEs pointing at page tables, CLINT, rx/tx buffers, flash, anywhere), stale TLBs (sfence skipped), MPRV/SUM/MXR/TVM/TW/TSR, timer/software interrupts, AMOs, LR/SC, FP, compressed, CSR (incl. illegal), ecall/ebreak/wfi/sfence.vma, putchar, automatic yields, accept/reject/exception/halt. Targeted states (targeted.lua, targeted2.lua): imcyclemax reached before any yield, mcycle near 2^64 with saturated imcyclemax, mcycle = 2^64-1 from creation, halt / exception / reject stopping mcycles, fixed points after each, no-op deliveries (Y=0, rejected, exception) followed by a step. JSON-RPC remote producers (rpc-check.lua): deliveries of 0, 1, 64 KiB, 2 MiB, 2 MiB+1, 3 MiB verified by C++ and EVM. Full Dave composition (stf-check.lua): released CartesiStateTransition (regenerated step) deployed on an osaka anvil (EIP-7825 cap, 30M block gas) with a provider computing the input Merkle root exactly as DaveConsensus (keccak check + LibBinaryMerkleTree): counter 0 delivery+step, counter 1 plain step, counter 2^20-1 step+reset, and the reverting step+reset at a rejection all return the emulator's canonical hash. Sizes/gas: plain step proof 13-19 KB (max 14 accesses seen), about 0.72 M gas through transitionState; step+reset 7 KB, about 0.35 M gas (0.51 M when reverting); delivery+step with the largest InputBox input (65,536 encoded bytes): proofs 93,992 bytes, calldata 94,180 bytes, eth_estimateGas 4.76 M (includes intrinsic/EIP-7623 floor, excludes Tournament.winLeafMatch overhead), i.e. under the 2^24 per-transaction gas cap and the 128 KiB txpool size limit; Dave's own Gas.WIN_LEAF_MATCH refund allocation is 5.536 M (a refund cap, not a limit).
not_covered: Every uarch step of every mcycle on the EVM: per uarch pc the first occurrence plus 0.05% random samples were EVM-verified; the C++ producer self-check (log_step_uarch replays every log) covered all logged steps, and in sparse mode only about 1 of 4 steps after the first 60 of an mcycle was logged (run_uarch skips the rest).

Full Tournament.winLeafMatch transaction through a deployed released Dave with a real InputBox/DaveConsensus (only CartesiStateTransition + an equivalent provider); Tournament overhead on top of the 4.76 M gas not measured.

Linux guest runs did not reach rejections (no snapshot of the 400 MB Linux template was taken), and the Linux sampling hit mostly ordinary mcycles; exhaustive trap-heavy Linux mcycles were not logged step by step.

Halt and exception stops were exercised only in targeted runs with the emit-output guest (the random guest reached accept/reject only); guest stores to HTIF through random mappings were not specifically targeted.

Worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle were not searched (the harness only asserts that the uarch halts before position 2^20-1); combinations of interrupt + trap + page-crossing fetch + flush in one mcycle not constructed deliberately.
PLIC-driven external interrupts, unusual template register values (girqpend/girqsrvd, ilrsc, iflags combinations), Sv48 superpages, and PMP/menvcfg variants beyond what the random CSR writes reach.
Chains with tighter per-transaction size limits than 128 KiB (for example Arbitrum's sequencer limit) and gas pricing on L2s.

The PRT player and bridge (support) producing these proofs end to end (prove_state_transition, run_to_uarch_cycle after restarts); only the emulator producers and the prt-ethereum encoding (via the harness client) were used.
sha256 machines (log producers refuse them by design) and main-processor step logs (ZK, out of scope).
